text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the request received on February 2, 2018 from 2266880 Ontario Inc., operating as Spirithouse, for an extension of operating hours of the boulevard café permit located at 487 Adelaide Street West, Unit 100, Portland Street flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the operating hours of the boulevard cafe permit located at 487 Adelaide Street West, Unit 100, Portland Street flankage, with the following conditions: a. The patio will have sound barriers at both the north and south ends. b. No amplified sound will be permitted on the patio at any time. c. The patio will stop operations and be cleared out no later than 11:59 p.m. each night from Sunday to Thursday, and no later than 1:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday (early Saturday and Sunday mornings). d. Signage in a prominent location will remind patrons to be considerate of the surrounding community and to not smoke in the side lane. e. A telephone number will be provided for neighbours to register concerns or complaints.
